g.text: N14 | Layers 5 to 9 pass the controlled rule-transfer test

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Opposite-rule donors switch 14/16 programs. Reversed-label same-rule donors preserve all 16. Retention: 8/8.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52636d

g.text: A full native site, not an identified individual neuron. Every declared condition and coding family is shown.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Gate: transfer at least 8; preservation at least 14; both domains, labels, mappings and directions; all retention correct.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Layer 0 fails the semantic control. Layers 0 to 13 miss the preservation threshold. Selection uses the fixed eligibility rule.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: 400 audited records, including 40 exact carried originals. 120 self checks, 120 generated identities and 20 restorations pass.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: All six nonrecipient donor policies have one incidental extremum gain. No original-model coding improvement is established.
